Page map: p01 cover + instructions (Section A compulsory, any four from Section B); p02 Section A, Q1(i)-(ii); p03 Q1(iii)-(v); p04 Q1(vi)-(viii); p05 Q1(ix)-(x); p06 Q1(xi)-(xiii); p07 Q1(xiv)-(xv), Q2(i); p08 Q2(ii)-(iii); p09 Q2(iv)-(v); p10 Section B, Q3(i)-(v), Q4(i)-(ii); p11 Q4(iii)-(v); p12 Q5(i)-(v); p13 Q6(i)-(v); p14 Q7(i)-(v) stem; p15 Q7(v)(a)-(c), Q8(i)-(iii); p16 Q8(iv)-(v). Numbering checked against the printed section headers and brackets: Section A 40 marks = Q1 [15] (15 MCQs (i)-(xv), 1 mark each) + Q2 (i)-(v) at [5] each = 25; Section B 40 marks = any four of Q3-Q8, each (i) [1] + (ii) [2] + (iii) [2] + (iv) [2] + (v) [3] = 10. Questions 1-8 run unbroken, every question's parts (i)-(v) present (Q1 to (xv)). No internal choice (OR) anywhere. Q1's [15] is printed once for the block; each MCQ row carries 1 mark. Every numbered part is its own row (ICSE rule); sub-parts (a)-(e) kept inside the row. Q1(ix), Q1(xi), Q2(iv), Q3(ii), Q4(v), Q5(v), Q7(v), Q8(v) carry illustrative photos/drawings recorded as required:false figures. Degrees printed as a superscript o are written ^{\circ}. rows.text:
Given below is the diagram of a human sperm. Read the information below the diagram and fill in the blanks:
*Living organisms reproduce to form new individuals of their own kind. This is essential for the survival and continuation of species. Human sperms are microscopic structures that carry genetic material.*
The head of the sperm has a cap like organelle called (a) ____ (Lysosome / Acrosome) which produces an enzyme (b) ____ (Hyaluronidase / Amylase) that dissolves the outer layer of the ovum to facilitate fertilisation. The nucleus of the sperm has (c) ____ (23 / 46) chromosomes. The middle piece has (d) ____ (Chloroplast / Mitochondria) to provide energy for the motility of the sperm. (e) ____ (Semen / Hymen) is a mixture of sperms and the fluids produced by the male accessory glands.

figure.note: Unlabelled drawing of a human sperm (head, middle piece, tail). All the blanks' choices are in the text.
